title: 複習三
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved review migration module R003; pair with R004. Milestone L060; coverage L031-L060; allowed-character ceiling through L060 only. Review modules introduce no new characters and have no zhuyin or charAudio.

generationConstraints.stage4PartialOrderRule: Blank exactly 3-4 Han characters. Every option card must be exactly one Han character; no chunks, phrase cards, or full-sentence reordering.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: Concrete phone-readable square image for: 這是媽媽的書。 Show the recurring protagonist mother holding or placing her own book, with the book clearly belonging to her through family context and body position, but without any written name or label. Use the recurring protagonist mother identity: warm adult family role in home clothing, visually distinct from teacher, passersby, and the L058 adult woman. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 爸爸會做好吃的。 Show the recurring protagonist father making tasty food at home, such as preparing a simple child-friendly meal on a kitchen counter. The food should look appealing, and father's action of making food should be clear. Use the recurring protagonist father identity: adult father matching the protagonist family, visually distinct from mother, teacher, and generic adults. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 我和媽媽都愛吃這個。 Show the recurring protagonist girl for `我` and the recurring protagonist mother happily eating or reaching for the same visible food item on the table, so both clearly like eating it. Use protagonist family identities. Mother must be visually distinct from teacher and the L058 adult woman. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

Concrete phone-readable square image for: 他走到水邊。 Show the recurring sporty boy for `他` walking toward the edge of safe shallow water, such as a calm pond or stream edge, with the water boundary clear. Keep the scene safe and calm; he is near the water edge, not falling in. Use the recurring `他` identity: sporty young boy with orange athletic shirt, navy shorts, red sneakers, green wristband, visually distinct from `你`. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.

approvedSentences.text: 兩隻狗都去水裡，他沒去。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 兩隻狗都去水裡他沒去
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Concrete phone-readable square image for: 兩隻狗都去水裡，他沒去。 Show two friendly dogs in shallow water while the recurring sporty boy `他` stays dry on the shore and does not go into the water. Make the contrast clear: both dogs are in the water, the boy is outside the water. Use the recurring `他` identity and two family dogs associated with `他` when useful. No written text, labels, numbers, signs, zhuyin, logos, or speech bubbles.
